verdict.rationale: Vestd's docs strongly support a live cap table as single source of truth: digital cap table management with 'one source of truth, reconciled' (vestd-docs-7), share issuance with Companies House auto-updates (vestd-docs-2, vestd-docs-11), share certificates (vestd-docs-31), SAFEs/growth shares (vestd-docs-17, vestd-docs-32), EMI/CSOP/unapproved option grants (vestd-docs-6, vestd-docs-14, vestd-docs-33, vestd-docs-34), and data rooms for investors/auditors to access cap tables and documents (vestd-docs-21). Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration (e.g. reviews or case studies) confirming investors/auditors actually rely on it as source of truth, and no direct evidence of multi-user real-time sync guarantees.
